subject: mathematics
concept: Finding the area of a rectangle by counting unit squares
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student covers a virtual rectangle with unit-square tiles and counts them
exercise.pictorial: Student counts squares on a pictured grid-covered rectangle
exercise.abstract: Student calculates area of a rectangle from given length and width (rows x columns)

misconception_flags: confuses area (square counting) with perimeter (edge adding)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
